exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Looking Forward to Eighteen
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: My eighteenth birthday is next month. I really can't wait!
Leo: Me too. What are you most looking forward to?
Mia: Being able to vote, I think. I want a say in how things are run.
Leo: That's a good one. For me, it's getting my driving licence.
Mia: Won't your mum worry about you on the road?
Leo: A little. But I think I'm mature enough to drive carefully.
Mia: I'm sure you are. Are you nervous about becoming an adult?
Leo: Not really. I know growing up is gradual, not something that happens overnight.
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 下个月满18岁,十分期待;Leo 也是;Mia 最盼望能投票、对事情有发言权;Leo 最盼望拿驾照;Mia 担心他妈妈会不放心;Leo 说自己够成熟、会小心开车;两人都明白成长是逐渐的,不是一夜之间发生的。

questions.stem: When is Mia's eighteenth birthday?
What is Mia most looking forward to?

Why isn't Leo very worried about driving?
options: He feels mature enough to be careful.
His mum will always drive him.

questions.stem: How do both speakers see growing up?
options: As something to be afraid of.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 The Age of Majority
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: In most countries, turning eighteen marks the start of adulthood.
This age is often called the age of majority.
At this point, young people can usually vote and sign legal papers.
They also become responsible for choices their parents once made.
Yet many young adults find that real change comes slowly, not overnight.
exercises.translation_cn: 在多数国家,年满18岁标志成年的开始;这个年龄常被称为"成年";到此时,年轻人通常可以投票、签署法律文件;他们也开始为从前由父母做的选择负责;但许多年轻人发现,真正的改变是慢慢到来的,而非一夜之间。

options: It happens in a single day.

It comes slowly rather than overnight.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Leaving Home for the First Time
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Hannah: I'm a bit worried about moving into the dormitory next week.
Mr Reed: That's natural. What worries you most?
Hannah: I've never lived away from home. I don't know how to cook or do laundry.
Mr Reed: Think of it as a chance to learn. You can always ask others for help.
Hannah: I'm also afraid I won't see my family as much.
Mr Reed: Why not speak to them regularly over the phone or by video call?
Hannah: That's a good idea. Maybe I'll join some clubs too, to make new friends.
Mr Reed: Exactly. Living in a group teaches you a lot about growing up.
exercises.translation_cn: Hannah 担心下周搬进宿舍;Reed 老师说这很正常,问她最担心什么;她从没离家住过,不会做饭和洗衣;老师说把这当作学习的机会,可以向别人求助;她还怕见不到家人;老师建议常打电话或视频;她觉得不错,还打算参加社团交新朋友;老师说集体生活会让人学到很多关于成长的东西。

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 The Little Prince
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The Little Prince was written by the French pilot Antoine de Saint-Exupéry.
It tells of a pilot who has crashed his plane in the desert.
While he tries to fix it, a little prince from another planet appears.
The two soon become close friends.
The book reminds us to look beneath the surface to find what truly matters.
exercises.translation_cn: 《小王子》由法国飞行员安托万·德·圣埃克苏佩里所写;讲述一位飞行员的飞机坠落在沙漠;他修飞机时,一位来自另一星球的小王子出现;两人很快成为好友;这本书提醒我们要看到表象之下,寻找真正重要的东西。

questions.stem: Who wrote The Little Prince?

options: A little prince from another planet.

questions.stem: What happens between the two characters?

options: Look beneath the surface for what truly matters.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 My First Pay Day
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Sam: Guess what? I got my first wage today!
Ella: That's wonderful! How does it feel?
Sam: Amazing. I earned every cent of it at the café this month.
Ella: So, are you going to spend it all at once?
Sam: No way. I've decided to save most of it.
Ella: That's very sensible. What will you do with the rest?
Sam: I'll give some to help with the household bills at home.
Ella: Your parents will be really proud of you, Sam.
exercises.translation_cn: Sam 今天拿到第一份工资,十分开心;Ella 替他高兴并问感受;Sam 说很棒,这是他这个月在咖啡馆挣的每一分钱;Ella 问他会不会一下子花光;Sam 说不会,决定把大部分存起来;剩下的会拿一些帮家里付账单;Ella 说他父母一定会为他自豪。

questions.stem: What good news does Sam share?
options: He got his first wage today.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 A Tip for Growing Up
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone who is growing up.
Real maturity is not only about new freedoms.
It is also about the small, everyday choices you make.
Try to act with integrity, even when no one is watching.
Step by step, these quiet choices shape the person you become.
exercises.translation_cn: 给正在成长的人一个简单的小贴士:真正的成熟不只是新获得的自由;它也在于你每天做出的小选择;努力以正直行事,哪怕无人在看;一步步地,这些不起眼的选择塑造你成为什么样的人。
